collection.description: A healer's apprentice questions a treatment taught by their mentor.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A healer's apprentice questions a treatment taught by their mentor.

choices.label: Try the apprentice's alternative with consent.
Let the patient choose among explained options.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The patient improves and the apprentice learns a useful technique.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The treatment fails, and the mentor agrees to review it.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The patient worsens, and the apprentice asks for help.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The consultation produces a cautious combined plan.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The healers disagree, and the patient requests a clearer explanation.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The patient values having a say in their care.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The patient asks for more time rather than deciding immediately.

b1__fx.name: Outcome B1
b1__fx.text: The patient experiences relief, though the cause is uncertain.

b1__text.name: Outcome B1
b1__text.text: The patient experiences relief, though the cause is uncertain.
